book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Muh wuchii kusɛ fitele fie lɛ keefɛ wu ge wu kwe gɛ

Gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le, bamii bamu ja bo sɛɛŋ Jiso kune bamii ba Galalee bamu ba gɛ̀ gɛnɛ ki bo ge kintanyɛ fɛ Nyo le, Balɛt tuŋ bamii bo gɛɛŋ bo gwoojɛ bo, bilɛmɛ biboo taashɛ bɛ bi nyáŋ yì bo gɛ gee kintanyɛ kɛɛ yu.
Jiso yege nɛɛ, wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ bamii bayu gɛ kwe kfuu chi yɛɛ kwe noo nje bimbefɛ biboo gɛ̀ fede bi bamii ba Galalee bamu noo?
Gɛ nyu noo gɛ. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, bɛŋ baaŋ kûsɛ gɛ muntele mwɛna gɛ, bɛŋ bachii lé bɛŋ kwêeyɛ gɛh noo.
Bɛŋ tane gɛh bamii ba yuufe ncho nyaaŋ baa ba yeh yì ndefe gɛ̀ kesɛ Siloŋ yi yuuyɛ bo? Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ bamii bayu gɛ̀ kweeyi noo nje bimbefɛ biboo gɛ̀ fede bi bamii ba Yɛlusalɛm bamu noo?
Gɛ nyu noo gɛ. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, bɛŋ baaŋ kûsɛ gɛ muntele mwɛna gɛ, bɛŋ bachii lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ kwêeyɛ gɛh noo.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune kite kì gɛ̀ yune gɛ muntaŋ gɛ
Jiso mo wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bee kife kimi le, muh mu yii kite ki muntaŋ a wu mwɛne.
Lɛ kife kojɛ, wu to ki wu kê, wu gɛ yɛŋ muntaŋ yuŋ yi ki le gɛ.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wù gɛ̀ jiiŋe fɛ mwɛ we le lɛ, ‘Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, le wa biluŋ bitɛde mɛɛse no ntoo ki ŋke muntaŋ yi kite kinɛ le, n'yɛde gɛ fiɛɛ le yi ki le gɛ. Gwôo lo. Ki baŋe nshɛŋ yinɛ achiji.’
Muh we wu lɛme wɛɛ chvuu lɛ, ‘Chiji kikwɛɛ, ka chinɛ gɛh yu kiluŋ kinɛ, nɛ ki baaŋ yuŋ gɛ, mɛ mo nchiŋ kinyi kiyu ŋgɛɛ chvune fo.
Sege bu kiluŋ kì too le ki yuŋ, fi joŋ, ki nɛ baaŋ yuŋ gɛ, mɛ mo ŋgwo lo.’”

content: Jiso fɛ kwɛse wumu juu chi yuuŋ
Gɛ̀ bee juu chi yuuŋ chimi, Jiso yɛyi bamii yeh yi buunɛ yimi le.
Kwɛse wumu nyu yu kiyo kì befe kimi nyu ye ye le, kì to ki ge muh tu muh wu chigoŋ. Ki gɛ ge wa wu chɛŋ yi biluŋ le yuufe ncho nyaaŋ jiŋ ŋgvuusɛ wu, taŋlo wu gɛ ka wu lɛɛŋ we chaaŋ gɛ.
Jiso yɛŋ kwɛse wuyu le wu tɛɛŋ wu wu to wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bwaaŋ, wo le wo bonɛ wa chiaaŋ yi goŋ yo yinɛ le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu chiaasɛ kibo wu kuŋ wu le. Kimimia, jiŋ yɛɛ kaasɛ yi nɛjɛ ye, wu lɛɛŋ we chaaŋ, wu mo wu tu wu tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo.

Chiji kikwɛɛ wu yeh yi buunɛ yiyu yɛŋ lɛ Jiso le wu fɛ kwɛse wuyu nyu juu chi yuuŋ, fiɛɛ fiyu toonyɛ lo wu baaŋ. Wu mo wu tu wu sage bamii le wu duu lɛ, “Aju a lɛme le bvusoo. Bɛŋ tôo ba fɛde binchɛŋ biɛna nyu ajuu kaa le. Keefɛ muh ka wu môŋ wu to juu chi yuuŋ lɛ gɛ.”
Tada chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bamii ba jɛme yeye, bɛŋ gee yeye banɛ. Nɛ le juu chi yuuŋ, muh wu mumwaa mumwaa abɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ gɛ ka wu jo kɛnɛ jaki fɛ wu chee fo wu gɛɛŋ wu nya wu joo gɛ?
Kwɛse wunɛ le nyu mwa Ablaham, debele nyu wu lee wa wu yeh yi ncha le biluŋ yuufe ncho nyaaŋ, fi baaŋ joŋ gɛ no ba bvusɛ wu yi ŋgɛ le juu chi yuuŋ gɛ?”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, bvuya koo bamii be ba kimbanɛ, bamii ba duude tu bo laŋe lo ye fiboo nje biŋgha bi mwɛɛ bichii bì Jiso gɛ̀ gee.
Ŋgaŋ kune fintaŋ fimi
Jiso ja wu ghaa lɛ

content.text: “Bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le njɛ la? Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo mbege yu le la?
Ka nyu gɛh njɛ ŋgo yi fintaŋ fimi fì muh gɛ̀ noŋ a wu mwɛne, yi gɛ̀ bu, yi ku yi yɛɛŋ yi tu kite kì munyii mu fuune we to mu joone yi chɛ́ yiyu le.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune kinshilɛ
Wu ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Taŋlo ŋka mbege bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bɛ la?
Ka nyu gɛh njɛ kinshilɛ kì kwɛse gɛ̀ fe mune bintee bì baaŋ baaŋ bitɛde wu jo wu fiiŋsɛ yu, wu tojɛ wu gɛɛ, fi mo fi ge mune chiyu bɛɛnyɛ.”

content: Jwe wu fwese wù fasaa
Jiso gɛ ja wu gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm. No wu gɛ gɛɛne wu fede bilaantɛŋ bɛ bantɛ le wu yɛyi bamii.
Muh mu ja wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, le bamii ba shige bo lé bo gê bo bônɛ?” Jiso mo wu chvuu wa nyu bamii le bachii lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ lûumɛ chuule ki bɛŋ lêe nyu fɛ jwe wu fwese kwɛɛ wu le fasaa le. Nje nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ bamii ba duude lé bo gê bo gôone ki bo lee bo gɛ kɛmɛ je gɛ.

Kife lé ki kôjɛ, kì chiji yeh lé wu jâ we wu faa kimbuŋ. Wu doo wu faa, bɛŋ mɛ akfuuŋ bɛŋ kune kimbuŋ bɛŋ lɛge lɛ, ‘Chiji Kikwɛɛ, gwenyɛ kimbuŋ be lee.’ Wu mo wu chvuu bɛŋ le lɛ, ‘Gɛ ŋkee a bɛŋ ja yo gɛ.’
Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛ bɛŋ taanyi lɛ, ‘Le bee ba chi jii mwɛɛ bee ka muu mwɛɛ. Wo gɛ jiɛnyi wo yɛyi bamii bantɛ besa le.’
Wu ka wu kaasɛ wu chvuu lɛ, ‘Nsɛŋe lo bɛŋ le lɛ gɛ ŋkee a bɛŋ ja yo gɛ. Bɛŋ ja lo a mɛ fwɛɛŋ bɛŋ banɛ bɛŋ jiɛnyi bɛŋ fige mwɛɛ.’
Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ Ablaham bɛ Asik mo Yakob mo bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo bachii antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo, bɛŋ nyu ba baŋ bɛŋ akfuuŋ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ beede bɛŋ ŋgeji bige.
Bamii lé bo jâ bimbe le bichii, kɛge a juu saane yo gɛɛne bude a chi seele yo mo aweawe bɛ akuuakuu a woŋ, bo to bo shii bo jii antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii bamu ba le ajiŋ mɛɛse lé bo gê bo nyû fwe, bamu ba le fwe mɛɛse lé bo gê bo nyû ajiŋ.”

content: Jiso kɛŋ ye bɛ Yɛlusalɛm
Lɛ nyu gɛh kife kiyu le, Bafalashii jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Bu fiuŋ wo ja wo gɛɛne kimbe kimi le nje Nfoŋ Hɛlod goone ki wu yû wo.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ du nchombiaŋ wuyu le lɛ mbvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele ye yi bamii le abɛŋ, ŋka nfɛde binchɛŋ, nyu gɛh no nlé mbû ŋge fɛwɛge, doo nyume fɛ bu shɛ ataana, mɛ mo mmɛsɛ lɛme chaŋ.
Geenɛ, nle ŋkɛ jiɛnyɛ waŋ wu Yɛlusalɛm abɛŋ, ŋka mbu njiɛnyɛ fɛwɛge gɛɛne bude fɛ bu she fɛwɛge. Fi baaŋ kojɛ gɛ lɛ ba yuuyɛ muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo kijusɛ kimi le fede Yɛlusalɛm gɛ.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ nɛ, wu mo wu kɛŋ ye lɛ,

content.text: “Yɛɛbɛɛ Yɛlusalɛm! Yɛɛbɛɛ Yɛlusalɛm! Wo wù yuuyi bamii ba ntuŋ ba Nyo, wo ka tume bamii ba Nyo tuŋ fɛ wo le bɛ ata. Le wa kiŋgane kimɛɛ no mɛ moŋ ki mbanyɛ booŋ buŋ njɛ no bweshii to wu banyɛ booŋ be yi kfugɛ, a bibɛɛ bie le, wo faŋ?
Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, yeh yo lé yi gê yi tu binfu. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ gɛ bɛŋ baaŋ bɛŋ ka bɛŋ yɛŋ mɛne gɛ, gɛɛne bude kife ki bɛŋ lé bɛŋ dû lɛ, ‘Nyo le wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi muh wu too a jee chi Tada Nyo le.’”

footnotes.text: Kite kiyu le ba tɛŋe a jɛ yi bala le lɛ, “Fig”.
